blob_data_access.what_it_proves: the pilot identity holds a blob DATA-plane role whose scope covers the account the transport actually writes to; the same query returns AMBIGUOUS rather than PRESENT for the account the job specification used to advertise, which does not exist

gpu_job_absence.name: job-jspace-s3-p0r2-pilot-g1
gpu_job_absence.what_it_proves: the bounded GPU pilot job does not exist, so nothing this stage did could have created or started it

identity_blob_canary.what_it_proves: P0-R2's own transport bytes -- which are not byte-identical to P0-R1's and therefore cannot inherit P0-R1's receipts -- can construct the real managed-identity client, write through it, and read back byte-exact, from the only place the question can be asked: a VNet-integrated CPU-only Container Apps job

in_build_image_audit.what_it_proves: the audit is not merely available at runtime: the build itself fails if the image does not carry exactly the executable commit's bytes, so an image that drifted could never have been pushed

job_absence_is_not_vacuous.what_it_proves: the same read-only query that reports PROVED_ABSENT for both bounded pilot jobs reports PROVED_PRESENT for the CPU-only canary job this stage did create, so the absence proofs are answers from Azure and not a query that cannot find anything

journal_self_check.what_it_proves: the create-only journal writes monotonic immutable sequences and reads them back; a duplicate sequence number is a defect, never a retry

packing_canary.what_it_proves: the exact host step that permanently stopped P0-R1 -- Azure CLI packing a context into a tar for upload -- now completes, because P0-R2 presents two files at a 40-character maximum native path instead of a repository tree at 265

prefix_preflight_is_not_vacuous.what_it_proves: the same preflight that reported PROVED_UNUSED for an unused prefix refused the prefix once objects existed under it, so the absence proof the pilot depends on is a real test and not a function that always says yes

preflight_canary.what_it_proves: inside the pinned image, every operational module imports and identifies itself, all 33 image blobs equal the executable commit's Git blobs, and a 1 MiB payload survives the transport envelope byte-identically with no repair accepted

recovery_job_absence.name: job-jspace-s3-p0r2-recover-g1
recovery_job_absence.what_it_proves: the CPU recovery job does not exist yet either
